source: POD-4837 probe: scratch GROK_HOME, a local fake OpenAI-compatible model server with a dummy key
redactions: The probe scratch directory is rewritten to /tmp/grokprobe. Grok's session/setup, MCP and session-list side channels and the available-command inventory are not selected.
timing: t is milliseconds since the probe client started; mark entries name each step.

promptIdAndMessageId.note: A: _meta.promptId is kept (every chunk, the reply). B: a top-level messageId is ignored (Grok mints a promptId). C: the same promptId again runs a second turn. D: no id, Grok mints one. No live user_message_chunk in any.

queuedWhileBusy.note: F sent while E runs: queue/changed lists F under its promptId behind running E; F runs after E ends.

repeatedPromptIdWhileBusy.note: G sent again while G runs: the queue shows no second entry, and G then runs a second turn under the same promptId.

userPromptSubmitHook.note: H allowed, I blocked, J allowed. The queue ack precedes the hook; a blocked prompt ends cancelled with cancellationCategory HookDenied and is not recorded.

providerFailure.note: The provider answers 402: queue ack, retry_state failed, turn_completed stop_reason error with the promptId, then a JSON-RPC error reply. The prompt is recorded.
